## Today’s learning {#l2-learning-goal}

### Lesson objective
Read and extend frequency tables, interpret cumulative frequency, and calculate summary statistics using tables and a calculator.

### Success criterion
I can explain what each column represents and use the table and calculator to find and check summary statistics.

::: notes
This is an Extension 1 class revisiting familiar summary statistics. Keep the reminder brief and focus teaching time on meaning, efficient calculation, calculator use and interpreting cumulative graphs.
:::
